text:
I understand your concern about sharing your email address. For security purposes, I need to authenticate your identity before I can access your order information or make any changes to your account.

If you're not comfortable providing your email, I can authenticate you using your first name, last name, and zip code instead. Would you be able to share those details with me?
zh:
我理解你关于分享电子邮件地址的担忧。出于安全目的，我需要在访问你的订单信息或对你的账户进行任何更改之前验证你的身份。

如果你不舒适提供你的电子邮件，我可以用你的名字、姓氏和邮政编码来验证你。你能和我分享这些详细信息吗？
